name: diet-advisor
description: Track daily food intake against personalized calorie and macro targets, kept in a portable data block that moves with you between assistants

interface.shortDescription: Calorie and macro tracking with personalized targets
interface.longDescription: Sets up a diet profile from your stats and goal, computes daily calorie and macro targets from published sources (Mifflin-St Jeor, ISSN position stands), then tracks every dish you log against them — with previews, corrections, history, and a reusable dish library. All data lives in one portable data block you can carry between assistants.
defaultPrompt: Use Diet Advisor to set up my diet profile and calculate my daily targets.
Use Diet Advisor to log a chicken rice bowl for lunch.
Use Diet Advisor to show how I'm doing on calories and macros today.
